questions.q: Rahul walks 5 m West, then turns right and walks 5 m, then turns right and walks 9 m. Which direction is Rahul facing now?
questions.why: Follow each turn from the first direction: the last leg is towards the East. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In a row of 49 students, Anil is 12th from the left and Ajay is 19th from the right. How many students sit between them?
If 27 May 2026 was a Wednesday, what day of the week was 14 July 2026?
questions.why: 48 days later; 48 mod 7 = 6, so count 6 days on from Wednesday. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Statements: All cats are dogs. All dogs are pets. Conclusions: I. Some cats are not pets. II. Some cats are pets.
questions.why: Checked against every possible diagram of the statements: I need not be true, II must be true. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Statement: Schools have multiplied, but most are ill-equipped and not excellent. Conclusions: I. We should give these schools good teachers and equipment. II. We need not open more schools.
questions.why: The problem stated is quality, which I addresses; II goes beyond the statement. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.

questions.q: What comes next in the series? 6, 11, 21, 41, 81, …
questions.why: Each term is ×2 − 1. Next: 161. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: 1 January 2007 was a Monday. What day was 1 January 2008?
questions.why: 2007 is not a leap year: one odd day. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2024.

questions.q: Statements: All files are records. Some records are confidential documents. Conclusions: I. Some files are confidential documents. II. Some confidential documents are records.
questions.why: II is the second statement turned around, so it follows. I does not: the confidential records need not be files.
